OPT EAD, GC EAD, GC, TN and Citizens Only 
 
 Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Position : IBM WebSphere MQSeries (MQ) Infrastructure Engineering 
 Location: Southfield, MI 
 Duration: 6-12 Months 
 
 Top 3 Skills: 
 1.) MQ Engineering/Design middleware 
 2.) Experience automating, configuring, installing MQ or other middleware 
 3.) Experience using monitoring tools to configure MQ ie.Tivoli 
 
 Technical Skills: Experience in the installation and configuration of MQ or similar middleware products on Linux, AIX, Solaris, Windows Server and AS/400. 
 Experience in automating the install/config of MQ or similar middleware products, using Linux, AIX, Solaris and Windows Server scripts. 
 Nice to have technical skills: 
 Experience in the development of applications that use MQ, using the standard MQ APIs (Connect, Open, Put, Get). 
 Experience using Tivoli-Omegamon or similar enterprise monitoring tools, preferably to monitor and configure MQ. 
 Other Skills: 
 A do-whatever-it-takes attitude and work ethic. 
 A strong desire to continually deepen MQ expertise. 
 A strong desire to learn all tangential technologies and processes involved with supporting MQ at Ford. 
 A strong team player and a desire to mentor and train less experienced team members. 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
